final class FooTest extends \PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase

    public function testA()
    {

        self::assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/x/', $a);
        static::assertFileDoesNotExist('f');
        $other->assertFileNotExists('f');
        $this->assertFileNotExists;
        assertFileNotExists('f');
        $this->assertDirectoryIsNotWriteable('d');
